```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parsed-entity-value'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?target data="processing-instruction-test"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Leading comment explaining the test case -->
  <sub:child id="c1">&ent;</sub:child>
  <child>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with markup: <child>nested</child> &ent;
    ]]>
  </child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtdMacro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment containing special characters <>&'" -->
  <book xlink:type="simple">Book authored by &author;</book>
  <note>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing unescaped entities &author; and tags <book>.
    ]]>
  </note>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base;Derived">
  <!ENTITY % extDecl " <!ELEMENT extra (#PCDATA)> ">
  %extDecl;
]>
<?pi-target processing instruction data here?>
<doc xmlns="http://ns.example.net/doc" xmlns:ns1="http://ns.example.net/ns1">
  <!-- Nested comment block --><!-- Another comment -->
  <ns1:section id="s1">&derived;</ns1:section>
  <extra>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Inside CDATA, looks like a comment but isn't -->
      <section>CDATA section content</section>
    ]]>
  </extra>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-debug log-level="verbose"?>
<archive xmlns="http://www.example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://www.example.org/meta">
  <!-- Complex comment header -->
  <meta:details>
    <![CDATA[
      Metadata payload: &ent2; with <tags> and attributes.
    ]]>
  </meta:details>
  <item>&ent2;</item>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product)*>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY company "Widgets Inc.">
  <!ENTITY % entitySet "
    <!ENTITY internal 'Internal Data'>
    <!ELEMENT description (#PCDATA)>
  ">
  %entitySet;
]>
<?custom-pi action="validate" target="inventory"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.example.com" xmlns:x="http://inventory.example.com/x">
  <!-- Comment about the product list and entities -->
  <product id="p1">&company; - &internal;</product>
  <description>
    <![CDATA[
      Description section with <product>&internal;</product> markup.
    ]]>
  </description>
  <x:product>Extra namespace product</x:product>
</inventory>
```
